text:
Alex Kim: Quick sync — can we clarify owners and next milestones for the console monitoring roadmap? specifically: dashboards (per-route + model), tracing hooks for runtime, error-analysis views, and retention milestones for traces/logs. who owns each and what deps are blocking?

Tara Mehta: I can own dashboards (per-route & model). current blocker is getting trace IDs emitted from runtime (eng-runtime). once we have that we can wire up traces -> route. ETA?

Mike Sargent: @Tara Mehta runtime team already has a small PR that adds trace_id header to the serving proxy, but needs review and a short canary. PR #4289. blocker is conf change in ingress config (eng-infra).

Yun Lee: allocating review time today for #4289. after merge I'll kick off a 2-hour canary on staging. can we define success criteria for the canary? latency & error slope only?

Tara Mehta: success: no >1% increase in p95 over baseline, trace linkage validates for >95% of sampled requests, and no increase in error-rate. logging sample events to verify joins.

Sara Patel: For error-analysis views, I can take ownership. need the trace->error join (so same trace_id in logs + kube metadata). Also need permission to pull 90d logs for initial rollout (pod labels attached). @eng-sre can you confirm retention change?

deploy-bot: Deployment proposed: eng-runtime PR #4289 -> merge -> canary -> promote. Noted owners: eng-runtime, eng-infra, eng-platform.

Alex Kim: Great. Let's record owners and next steps:
- Dashboards (per-route/model): Owner = Tara Mehta. Next step: wait for #4289 merge -> staging canary (Yun).
- Tracing hooks (runtime header): Owner = Mike Sargent / eng-runtime. Next step: finish review + ingress config update (eng-infra).
- Error-analysis views: Owner = Sara Patel. Next step: once trace_id available, wire logs -> traces, build initial dashboard.
- Retention milestones: Owner = eng-sre (unassigned here). proposed: traces 30d standard, 90d for sampled/on-demand. need signoff from finance for cost impact.

Mike Sargent: adding a short config snippet for ingress (will paste in PR):
```
proxy_set_header X-Trace-Id $request_id;
# ensure request_id propagated to downstream
```
I'll add tests and docs in the PR.

Yun Lee: Canary plan: 2h on staging with 10% traffic, capture p95, error-rate, trace-link coverage. I'll post results in this thread.

Sara Patel: For the error view, I want an initial set of queries: top exceptions by model, top routes by error-rate, and a trace sample tab. Will prototype in dashboard playground and share link.

Tara Mehta: Dependencies noted: eng-runtime (header), eng-infra (ingress config), eng-sre (retention + perms), finance (cost approval for 90d). Can we assign eng-sre owner here? @Yun ping eng-sre?

Yun Lee: pinging eng-sre in #eng-sre now. cc @OnCall-SRE (IANA)

eng-sre response (from OnCall-SRE): we can take retention ownership. initial approval: traces 30d default, 90d for sampled traces behind a flag. finance asking for numbers; I'll get cost delta by EOD.

Alex Kim: OK — owners and immediate actions:
- eng-runtime: finish PR #4289 (Mike) — due EOD today.
- eng-infra: apply ingress config update after PR review (owner: Michael B) — block ETA tomorrow.
- eng-platform (dashboards): Tara to wire views once traces available — start prototype tomorrow.
- eng-sre: retention + perms + cost calc (OnCall-SRE) — cost calc by EOD.
- eng-ml / product: please flag any metric requirements for model-level breakdowns (cc @Sara).

Mike Sargent: I merged #4289 to staging at 1980078800, started canary at 1980079200.

Yun Lee: Canary results (1980082500): p95 +0.1%, error-rate unchanged, trace-linkage 97% for sampled requests. Looks good.

Tara Mehta: nice. I'll start wiring dashboards tonight. Sara — when you have prototype link drop it here.

Sara Patel: Prototype: https://dashboards.internal/r/obs/proto (shared). initial queries added. need permission for pod label joins (eng-sre).

OnCall-SRE: cost delta estimate: +12% monthly infra for 90d sampled traces. finance follow-up needed.

Alex Kim: Thanks all. Actions captured. I'll update the roadmap doc with owners and target milestone dates. If anyone wants to reassign, speak up here. Otherwise we'll mark this as owner-confirmed and move to tracking. :white_check_mark:
